title: CLIP paired-retrieval capstone

paper.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement CLIP paired-retrieval capstone: align licensed image-caption pairs using symmetric contrastive loss and report retrieval recall; explicit Gold capstone exception. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use licensed-image-caption-pairs; required output: Image and text -> normalized paired embeddings. Evaluate retrieval_recall_at_1 (maximize). Gold capstone exception; evaluate both retrieval directions on held-out pairs. Required ablation: Compare one-directional and symmetric contrastive losses. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
